$Comment: The Headless Horseman on foot: the game's Burnt Knight skeleton with its skull gone, in his own armour (the collar chest, legs and hands in Items/Hallows_Eve/Horseman_Armor/, the same pieces his chase set is made of), with a fire burning in his neck and a lit jack-o'-lantern swinging from his left hand. Parent Skeleton_Burnt_Knight brings the burnt bones' texture, the hitbox and every animation; Model is this pack's copy of the Skeleton's shape with the skull's three shapes hidden (tools/derive_art.py writes it), so the animations still find every node. DefaultAttachments replaces the parent's list whole: the knight's helm, glowing eyes, chest piece and steel limbs all go, and his armour goes on, each piece in its plain texture. He wears no helm, since there is no head to wear it. The flame burns green on the collar chest's Fire node, the green ember in his neck hole: a model's Particles reach a node its attachments bring, as the game's Goblin Duke lights the bottles on his chest armour. Fire_Green is the game's green campfire (the emerald brazier's), and Color tints it toward the ember's own green, the way the game's Goblin Miner tints its candle flame; change Color to retint it, or SystemId to Campfire_New_Cartoon for an orange fire. Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_HM is this model in the gold textures for the hard ride. AnimationSets adds only the five sets his dash plays (his roles stand on Hallows_Eve_Template_Horseman_Foot, whose charge asks for DashPrepare, Dash, DashImpact, DashMiss and DashCrash), pointed at the skeleton's own animations; every other set still comes from the parent. DashPrepare carries his wind-up war cry (SFX_Skeleton_Elite_Downstrike_Charging, the cry the game's elite skeleton gives as it winds up its charged downstrike). MinScale and MaxScale fix his size at a quarter again a skeleton's; Light is the green glow of the fire in his neck, a model light that moves with him, each hex digit a red, green or blue level from 0 to f.
